purpose: Reversible consolidation of historical GitHub branch refs; never merge archived research branches into main automatically
guardrails: Create and verify a tag at the exact original commit before deleting any branch
Skip changed branch heads, protected branches, open pull requests, ref/tag conflicts and any API errors
Do not alter code, experimental results, issue states, current Git history or evaluation datasets
Branch archive tags retain historical unmerged commits, including negative results and unfinished experiments
